title: DMFeedbackResult
description: Output of the boss step (review). Stakeholder review with concerns, severity, fix suggestions. Ported from webapp's DMFeedbackResult + unified ReviewFeedback (src/stores/types.ts:849, 870).

mbti_type.description: TONE skin code (legacy field name kept for reader compat). Records boss.tone (or legacy boss.mbti_code); null when no tone was set or the review ran in generic-stakeholder mode. Storage metadata only — never surfaced in the report (R42).

seat.description: The stakeholder seat this review spoke from (O3 방3) — echo of config boss.owns/goals/authority at review time.

first_reaction.description: One-line first impression in the boss's voice. NO report-speak.

good_parts.description: 2-3 specific strengths. Must cite what section/point.

concerns.description: May be EMPTY: on a clean, reversible, verified scaffold, `concerns: []` plus one approval_condition is the correct honest output (R42 restraint / the mirror clause — a stakeholder who invents objections to seem rigorous is over-firing). The old minItems:1 rule forced concern manufacturing and is deliberately retired (O3 방3). When concerns exist, each must be anchored to the seat.

text.description: The concern — must point to WHERE (section/line).

seat_basis.description: Which owned stake this concern threatens — the seat's objective function speaking (e.g. '배포 안정성 소유자로서'). The mechanical form of R42: no seat, no concern.

severity.description: critical = blocker; important = should fix before ship; minor = nice-to-have.

fix_suggestion.description: Actionable direction. 'Here's how to fix it' — concern without fix is forbidden.

applied.description: User's decision on whether to apply this fix. critical defaults to true.

approval_condition.description: 'If you fix X, this is ready.' One specific sentence.

mode.description: Review depth: quick = hallway conversation (~150 words); deep = team meeting. Independent of persona: generic-stakeholder runs are marked by mbti_type: null, not by mode.

would_ask.description: Deep mode only. Questions the boss would ask in a meeting.

failure_scenario.description: Deep mode only. Concrete scenario where this plan fails (2-3 sentences).

untested_assumptions.description: Deep mode only. What the document takes for granted that might not be true.
